maria: Heads up — main CI just flipped red right after the merge of PR #3421. Smoke job `runtime-smoke-gpu` OOMing on kvcache allocation. Anyone on this? :eyes:

devops-bot: [CI] Pipeline failed: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/98765/builds/4440001234 - failed jobs: runtime-smoke-gpu (oom) - artifact: /artifacts/4440001234/log.txt

liam: I can take a look. Do we have the failing log tail?

maria: paste of the tail:
```
E tensorflow: allocation failed: OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 2.1GiB
  at KVCACHE::AllocShard()
  at runtime::init_cache()
  ...
```

sophia: hmm could be the new kvalloc change from the PR. @liam try a rerun first to rule out transient infra hiccup.

oncall-rotations: I'm oncall — kicking a rerun now: `./ci rerun --build 4440001234 --job runtime-smoke-gpu`

devops-bot: Rerun started by oncall-rotations (build 4440001235)...

devops-bot: Rerun finished — still failing (oom).

liam: OK rerun failed too. Can someone bisect? Quick bisect script: `scripts/ci-bisect --job runtime-smoke-gpu --good 4440001200 --bad 4440001234` — will try now.

andre: if bisect points to PR #3421 we should either hot-revert or pin older kvalloc config. :facepalm: pinging @maria to open revert PR if confirmed.

liam: bisect indicates first bad at commit `c7f9d2` (merged from PR #3421). Opening a revert now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3423 — please eyeballs from infra owners.

maria: thanks all. tagging infra leads and escalation channel. I'll monitor and coordinate rollback if CI doesn't clear. :thumbsup:
